summary: Talos Energy Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an indenture for $800M 8.000% second-priority senior secured notes due 2034. Proceeds will partially fund its pending Gulf of America acquisition of oil and gas assets (Na Kika and Coulomb fields) from Shell Offshore Inc., redeem its outstanding 9.000% notes due 2029, and pay fees. The acquisition is subject to a purchase agreement dated June 30, 2026, with an outside date for closing. The notes are secured by collateral and guaranteed by subsidiaries. Watch for regulatory clearance and timely closing; risk-arb focuses on financing completion and asset integration.
